title: ActionsPanel syntax highlighter: add string, comment, and number token colouring
description: The ScriptEditor overlay in ActionsPanel.tsx uses highlightLine() which only colours AS2 keywords (blue/bold). String literals (\'...\' and "..."), line comments (//...), block comments (/* ... */), and numeric literals are rendered in the default text colour, making scripts harder to read. Extend the tokeniser to handle these token classes: strings in orange/tan (#ce9178 VS-Code style), comments in green (#6a9955), numbers in light-green (#b5cea8). The tokeniser must be stateful across lines for block comments. Guard against regex catastrophic backtracking on very long scripts. Cover with unit tests for each token type.
